Title

DescriptivesTable.Rd

Title

Usage

DescriptivesTable(
  popdf,
  table_metadata,
  groupcol = "group",
  output_format = "processed",
  calculate_asd = TRUE,
  keep_varinfo = TRUE,
  label_lookup = NULL,
  control_types = TRUE,
  missing_vars = NULL,
  missing_flag = -99,
  round_decimals = FALSE,
  use_weights = FALSE,
  weighted_stats = FALSE,
  output_asd = TRUE,
  asd_per_level = FALSE
)

Arguments

popdf

input data frame / data.table containing the population of interest

table_metadata

metadata describing the variables, their types and levels, headers etc.

groupcol

name of column in which group membership can be found, defaults to "group"

output_format

"processed" or "raw"; raw better for debugging

calculate_asd

option; calculate asd and add to table or not

keep_varinfo

display option; keep additional raw variable information or only labels

label_lookup

optional table of lookup values to recode category labels

control_types

optional to control resetting of types

missing_vars

optional; check for variables which should be recoded as missing

missing_flag

optional; flag for missing values

round_decimals

defaults to FALSE; otherwise, an integer specifying rounding

use_weights

defaults to FALSE; if weighted asd required, supply name of the column in popdf which defines these weights

weighted_stats

defaults to FALSE; if TRUE, counts and descriptive statistics are weighted by the column named in use_weights. Weights are used as supplied

output_asd

optional; return a list containing a table and an object specifying the ASDs only

asd_per_level

defaults to FALSE; if TRUE, categorical variables get a per-category ASD on each of their category rows, in addition to the overall ASD on the header row

Details

use_weights and weighted_stats can be combined as follows:

use_weightsweighted_statsASD columncounts and statistics
FALSEFALSEunweightedunweighted
"iptw"FALSEweightedunweighted
"iptw"TRUEweightedweighted
FALSETRUEerrorerror
